note: Generated from content.js extractFeatures(); column order = CSV order. tests/dom_features.test.js fails if this drifts.

features.name: dom_n_forms
features.description: Forms on the page (incl. same-origin iframes)

features.name: dom_n_password_fields
features.description: input[type=password] count

features.name: dom_n_password_visible
features.description: Password fields a person can see

features.name: dom_n_password_hidden
features.description: Password fields hidden by display/visibility/zero-size layout (includes closed modals and inactive login steps)

features.name: dom_n_password_stealth_hidden
features.description: Password fields made invisible by opacity 0, off-screen position or 1px size while still fillable

features.name: dom_n_hidden_credential_inputs
features.description: Hidden inputs whose name/id matches pass|credential|secret (original coarse rule)

features.name: dom_n_forms_cross_origin
features.description: Forms posting to a different origin (scheme+host+port)

features.name: dom_n_forms_cross_site
features.description: Forms posting to a different registrable domain (www->auth subdomain is NOT counted)

features.name: dom_n_forms_http
features.description: Forms posting over http://

features.name: dom_n_password_forms_cross_origin
features.description: Password forms posting to a different origin

features.name: dom_n_password_forms_cross_site
features.description: Password forms posting to a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_n_password_forms_http
features.description: Password forms posting over http://

features.name: dom_n_forms_null_action
features.description: Forms with empty, # or javascript: action (common in SPAs and in kits)

features.name: dom_n_iframes
features.description: iframe count

features.name: dom_n_hidden_iframes
features.description: Hidden iframes

features.name: dom_n_hidden_iframes_with_form
features.description: Hidden same-origin iframes containing a form

features.name: dom_password_without_form
features.description: 1 if a password field exists but no <form>

features.name: dom_n_resources
features.description: img/script/stylesheet/icon/media resources with an http(s) URL

features.name: dom_n_ext_resources
features.description: Of those, loaded from a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_ext_resource_ratio
features.description: dom_n_ext_resources / dom_n_resources

features.name: dom_n_ext_sites
features.description: Distinct external registrable domains used by resources

features.name: dom_n_ext_scripts
features.description: External <script src> from a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_favicon_present
features.description: 1 if a <link rel=icon> exists

features.name: dom_favicon_foreign
features.description: 1 if any favicon is hosted on a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_n_links
features.description: Anchors with href (mailto/tel excluded)

features.name: dom_null_link_ratio
features.description: Share of links that are empty, # or javascript:

features.name: dom_ext_link_ratio
features.description: Share of links pointing to a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_meta_refresh
features.description: 1 if <meta http-equiv=refresh> exists

features.name: dom_meta_refresh_cross_site
features.description: 1 if the meta refresh target is a different registrable domain

features.name: dom_n_inline_scripts
features.description: Inline <script> blocks (capped at 200)

features.name: dom_inline_script_bytes
features.description: Total inline script characters scanned (capped 100k each)

features.name: dom_script_eval
features.description: 1 if inline script contains eval(

features.name: dom_script_atob
features.description: 1 if inline script contains atob(

features.name: dom_script_obfuscation
features.description: 1 if inline script uses unescape(, String.fromCharCode or long \x escapes

features.name: dom_script_document_write
features.description: 1 if inline script calls document.write(

features.name: dom_brand_in_title
features.description: 1 if title / og:site_name / application-name names a known brand

features.name: dom_brand_domain_mismatch
features.description: 1 if a named brand has no relation to the page's registrable domain
